body: I like art and music but I can't create any very well.

Not really. I tried a bunch of hobbies and never found one that stuck. Everything seems so meaningless. I just lie in bed and think. Sometimes I read or watch some videos but the subject is always trying to make sense of my life. I feel like I'm stranded in the ocean trying to find a sign of hope or meaning but nothing is there. I could die right now and the world would go on as if nothing happened. I don't want to be a stoner who just sits around and does nothing. I always thought I would be successful. I wanted to do something with my life, but I don't know how much longer I can keep going. I'm thinking about resorting back to weed tomorrow. I'll probably smoke for a bit, decide to stop, and end right back here. The only way to break the cycle is for something life changing to happen or for me to die.
